title: Good health, sobriety and musical integrity
summary: He no longer drinks, practises hours daily and tries his best.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: I'm very fortunate really I mean I can still play, still have my teeth. I always took good care of my teeth, they're all mine. (LAUGHTER). And I feel very grateful and thank the Lord that he's blessed me with good health. And I don't drink that whiskey any more assure you. A lot of years.....
That's such a marvellous thing. In nine years you haven't touched a drop?
Not a drop of alcohol, no. And I'm happy about it. I don't take anything. I don't take, you know, no dope, nothing like that, nothing. I smoke cigarettes, but I don't take anything and I
find it's a lot of fun. Nice and clear and enjoy every day and doing something no matter.....
At least you know what's going on every day don't you? (LAUGHTER).

I sure do. But good health is a wonderful thing. And you enjoy the days and what happens and look forward to playing the horn and believe me I practice three and four hours a day when I'm not working. If I am working, I'll just warm up at home for maybe an hour. Intersperse the time to get my embouchure loose. But I need that warm up.

When I'm not working steady I must put in those hours practice. I must do it. Otherwise you lose your endurance and you can't play. You can't do a good job. And what is there in life if you go on a job if you don't give your best effort and it doesn't matter what you're doing, you've got to give your best effort. There's no second place on that stuff. Do your best. And you must within yourself, this is your own self respect. Integrity, musical integrity to the art of music.
It's just like going out on the stage to perform you've got only one chance to do it.
That's right. And you must be prepared for it.

And you have to work, it's not work, it's enjoyable because to me I know that if I practice don't hard, I/mean hard, practice an amount of time, that when I go out to perform I know I can do a creditable job. It might not always be the greatest, but it isn't going to be down there in that low category.
And so if it's not your best in many incidences you're the only one who know it?

This is what kills me all the time, people, I'll get up at times and play and so forth and some people, somebody will say, oh that was marvellous. And I say to myself, inside, Jimmy that wasn't you know. But I just learn to say well thank you but inside I say to myself, sorry buddy, you weren't up there that time. You just can't reach those heights and it's a beautiful thing when you do. It's a lovely feeling ....
An inner glow that you get.
You know it inside yourself that you played well. But you always try.
